title: Until Death Do You Part
summary: A bride-to-be is found drowned during her hen party.
method: The victim was killed earlier when the rest of the group were drinking together. The killer left the group briefly, drowned her friend, and applied salt to the candles so they'd burn slower.
motive: The groom-to-be used to date the killer and through one of his trivia answers, the killer found out that she had been cheated on and this led to a series of events that caused her sister to die in a car accident.
notes:
This is Camille's last regular appearance. 
It's clear that Florence was never intended to be a sergeant character because she mostly follows Camille around in the last few episodes and doesn't develop a personality until she becomes DS.
